entities.name: Jack Chierdagh
entities.description: A kithkin scout of the Mistmeadow doun on Shadowmoor, later Hero of Mistmeadow, secretly in love with Keeley Welk.

entities.name: Mistmeadow
entities.description: A kithkin doun threatened by Rosheen.

entities.name: Keeley Welk
entities.description: Daughter of Molla Welk, loved by Jack.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: Giant pursuing her runaway cloudgoat, threatening Mistmeadow.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Offered help to Mistmeadow and sent faeries to help Jack.

entities.name: Donal Alloway
entities.description: The Kinscaer cenn who offered help and an alternative move to Kinscaer.

entities.name: Captain Sygg
entities.description: Leader of a merrow brigand group.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A strange kithkin who saved Jack and gave him a wingbow.

entities.name: Veesa
entities.description: Faerie of the Vendilion clique who helped Jack.

entities.name: Iliona
entities.description: Faerie of the Vendilion clique who helped Jack.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Faerie queen whose loyalists wanted the scroll.

events.summary: Jack volunteers to retrieve Rosheen's scroll and lure her from the doun.
events.quote: Jack, as the best scout, volunteered to go on a mission to retrieve Rosheen's scroll

events.summary: Jack kills a merrow looter and is saved from Sygg by Brigid, who gives him a wingbow.
events.quote: Jack killed one of the Merrow looters and was saved from Sygg's wrath by Brigid's intervention

events.summary: Veesa and Iliona help Jack retrieve the scroll and defend him from Oona's loyalists; he is lightly poisoned.
events.quote: The fae helped him retrieve the scroll

events.summary: Jack wakes near Mistmeadow without the scroll, Rosheen diverted, and becomes the official Hero of Mistmeadow.
events.quote: became the official Hero of Mistmeadow

events.summary: Many Mistmeadowers take Alloway's offer and move to Kinscaer; the rest stay.
events.quote: many Mistmeadowers took Alloway's offer and were moving to Kinscaer

events.summary: Jack, Brigid and the Wilt-Leaf elves help defend the doun against Ashling the Destroyer.

relations.quote: Jack was secretly in love with Keeley Welk
the daughter of the doun cenn , Molla Welk
Brigid then gave Jack a strange weapon
